risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and explains the drivers of declining sales, store closures, pricing pressure, and lower operating income, while noting continued profitability and no bank borrowings. Risk tone is mildly negative because of multi-year sales and comparable-store declines, but management expresses confidence in liquidity and anticipated funding sufficiency. Forward-looking language relies on broad, standard risk-factor disclaimers and includes a non-update disclaimer.
